$comment: Machine-readable feature tracker. WIP=1: only ONE feature may be 'in_progress' at a time. 'passing' means an automated/launch verification actually ran and passed. Features whose ONLY remaining verification needs the user's live machine (Google login, real audio, a physical keypress) are marked 'blocked' with reason 'code complete; awaiting manual acceptance' - the code IS written and builds; see notes/evidence. Statuses: not_started | in_progress | blocked | passing.

features.title: Menubar control surface
features.user_visible_behavior: A menubar (status bar) item appears with no Dock icon and no window; its title reflects the current mode (JZ/PH) and play state. Its menu offers Toggle, Play/Pause, Settings, and Quit.
verification: launch smoke: PhonkJazz.app/Contents/MacOS/PhonkJazz runs as .accessory (no Dock icon), process persists; menu built with Toggle/Play-Pause/Settings/Quit
features.evidence: Implemented in Sources/PhonkJazz/{main,AppController}.swift. Verified 2026-08-06: launches accessory/no-Dock, process alive 3s+, make check green. Visual title/menu render best-confirmed by the user via `make dev`.

features.title: AppConfig model + persistence
features.user_visible_behavior: Two playlist URLs (jazz, phonk) are held in AppConfig, persisted as JSON under Application Support with the user's playlists as defaults; missing/corrupt config falls back to defaults without crashing.
verification: make test — ConfigTests: playlistURL mapping, URL validation, JSON round-trip, default fallback (4/4 pass)
features.notes: Defaults are the user's supplied jazz/phonk playlist URLs.

features.title: Embed YouTube Music web player with persistent login
features.user_visible_behavior: An off-screen WKWebView loads music.youtube.com using a persistent data store; the user signs into Google in-app once and stays logged in across relaunches.
verification: manual (make dev): sign into Google in the WebView, quit, relaunch — still logged in
features.evidence: Code complete in Sources/PhonkJazz/{PlayerController,PlayerWindowController}.swift (WKWebsiteDataStore.default(), mediaTypes... = []). 'Sign in / Show Player…' menu item surfaces the WebView in a window for login. Builds clean.
features.notes: Blocked only on manual acceptance: open 'Sign in / Show Player…', log into Google once, then verify login persists across a relaunch. No longer blocked on missing UI.

features.title: JS-injected playback control
features.user_visible_behavior: The app loads a playlist URL and starts/pauses playback via evaluateJavaScript; audio actually plays.
verification: manual (make dev): trigger play — audio starts; trigger pause — audio stops
features.evidence: Code complete in Sources/PhonkJazz/{PlayerController,YTMScript}.swift (autoplay retry after didFinish). Builds clean.
features.notes: Blocked only on manual acceptance: needs real audio + a logged-in session. YTM selectors are centralized in YTMScript.swift; confirm against live DOM and tune autoplay if the player needs a user gesture.

features.title: Toggle playlist by mode
features.user_visible_behavior: Invoking toggle flips jazz<->phonk: loads the other mode's playlist, starts it playing, and updates the menubar to reflect the new mode.
verification: make test — Mode.toggled invariant + config lookup (passing)
manual (make dev): toggling switches the playing playlist and updates the status item
features.evidence: Logic verified: ModeTests + ConfigTests green. Wiring complete in AppController.toggleMode(). Full behavior (audio switch) pending manual acceptance.
features.notes: Blocked only on the audio half; the pure logic is covered by tests.

features.title: Global toggle shortcut (Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+J)
features.user_visible_behavior: Pressing Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+J from any app toggles the mode, with no Accessibility permission prompt.
verification: manual (make dev): focus another app, press Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+J, confirm the playlist toggles
features.evidence: Code complete in Sources/PhonkJazz/GlobalHotKey.swift (Carbon RegisterEventHotKey, kVK_ANSI_J + control|option|cmd). Builds/links clean.
features.notes: Blocked only on manual acceptance: requires a physical keypress on the user's machine.

features.title: Settings window to edit playlists
features.user_visible_behavior: Selecting Settings opens a window to edit the jazz and phonk playlist URLs; saving validates them, persists them, and takes effect for the next toggle.
verification: manual (make dev): open Settings, change a URL, save, toggle — new playlist is used; invalid URL is rejected with an alert
features.evidence: Code complete in Sources/PhonkJazz/SettingsWindowController.swift (validates via AppConfig.isValidPlaylistURL, persists via ConfigStore). Builds clean.
features.notes: Blocked only on manual acceptance: requires the GUI. Validation logic itself is covered by ConfigTests.testURLValidation.

features.title: Assemble distributable menubar .app bundle
features.user_visible_behavior: `make app` produces a PhonkJazz.app whose Info.plist marks it LSUIElement (menubar-only), launchable by double-click and eligible as a login item.
verification: make app builds PhonkJazz.app; PlistBuddy shows LSUIElement=true; the bundle binary launches as a persistent accessory process
features.evidence: Makefile `app` target. Verified 2026-08-06: bundle built (Contents/{Info.plist,MacOS/PhonkJazz}), LSUIElement=true, launches menubar-only.
features.notes: Unsigned — Gatekeeper may require right-click > Open on first launch, or an ad-hoc/Developer ID signature (follow-up).
